content: {"summary":"Customers complain that seat changes during upgrades move them away from preferred seats, causing frustration [#tk_2379113] [#tk_536127]. They want clear explanations for seat reassignments and the ability to choose seats after an upgrade [#tk_1151943] [#tk_519951]. Many report being separated from companions when upgraded, and wish for a setting that keeps adjacent seating [#tk_132695] [#tk_1120748]. Some cannot assign seats or see their partner’s seat after a split reservation, leading to confusion [#tk_2666140] [#tk_2875350]. Finally, passengers desire advance notice of seat restrictions and the option to modify upgrades post‑purchase [#tk_558654] [#tk_2957943]."}
